info.name: Look up technologies and related website intelligence

params.name: urls
params.description: Between one and ten website URLs, comma separated. Multiple URLs are not supported with `recursive=false`.

params.name: live
params.description: Scan websites in real time instead of relying on cached results when needed.

params.name: recursive
params.description: Follow internal links for increased coverage. Asynchronous when true and a crawl is required.

params.name: callback_url
params.description: Public callback URL that receives asynchronous lookup results.

params.name: debug_email
params.description: Debug-only email address that receives callback troubleshooting information.

params.name: sets
params.description: Comma-separated list of additional result field sets to include. Use `signals` to request `technologySpend` and `trafficLevel`.

params.name: min_age
params.description: Return results verified at least this many months ago.

params.name: max_age
params.description: Return results verified within the last `max_age` months.

params.name: squash
params.description: Merge monthly results into a single result set.

items.docs:
Looks up one or more websites. The response can complete synchronously
or return pending crawl markers when an asynchronous crawl is required.
